About Us

The team behind SMSEdge

Edge Opti Tech LTD builds the multi-channel messaging platform trusted by 4,000+ businesses worldwide. We power billions of messages across SMS, Email, Voice, and WhatsApp.

Our Story

Built for performance

SMSEdge was created to solve a real problem: SMS marketing lacked the tools, transparency, and optimization that other channels had. We built a platform where marketers can send, test, and scale campaigns with the same precision as digital advertising.

Our proprietary multi-route SMS technology uses real-time and historic CTR data alongside mobile test phones to keep costs down while maintaining high deliverability. The platform automatically selects the best SMS routes for each country in your list.

Today, SMSEdge is a full multi-channel messaging platform supporting SMS, Email, Voice, and WhatsApp -- serving affiliates, agencies, and enterprises across 195+ countries.

Our Values

What drives us

Delivery First

We obsess over deliverability. Our multi-route SMS technology ensures your messages reach subscribers across 195+ countries.

Data Driven

Every decision is backed by real-time data. From route optimization to campaign analytics, we let the numbers guide us.

Customer Success

Our managers take customer success personally. We make sure customers are always supported with the highest level of care.

Innovation

We continuously push the boundaries of messaging technology, from AI-powered optimization to multi-channel orchestration.
